item.title: 1st Source puts $100K into LaPorte–Porter storm recovery as Valpo cleanup and state aid continue
item.description: 1st Source Bank Foundation pledged $100,000 to seven nonprofits aiding LaPorte and Porter storm recovery as Valparaiso debris cleanup and state/federal aid windows continue.

item.title: AWS jobs pipeline: New Carlisle training to Jasper County’s Project Rise
item.description: AWS’s northern Indiana data-center buildout is producing local jobs and Ivy Tech training pathways from New Carlisle toward Jasper County’s Project Rise, with attributed pushback on water and wetlands.

item.title: Porter County brings in special prosecutors for two Flock LPR cases
item.description: Porter Superior Court appointed outside prosecutors Fagan and Taulman to review alleged Flock LPR misuse by a former Chesterton detective and a sheriff’s deputy after Prosecutor Germann sought to avoid appearance of impropriety.
